name: Layered Blocker Marbles
description: Some boxes hide 3 neutral blocker marbles among their colored ones. Blockers can never be served, so they crowd the conveyor — but the moment 9 of them are riding the belt at once, the charger sweeps all 9 off in one burst and resets, ready to fill again.
howToPlay: Tap boxes to drop marbles onto the belt. Colored marbles get served to matching trays, but the gray blocker marbles never leave on their own and pile up. Watch the charger meter under the belt fill one pip per blocker — tap blocker boxes (gray-striped, with a little lock) until 9 are on the belt and the charger auto-sweeps them away, then do it again. There are 21 blockers here, so the charger fires twice and the last 3 keep circling as clutter. Clear all the colored marbles to win.
author: Ilayda Arslan
